purpose: Synthetic-only preparation for a later steward-approved calibration freeze.

bindings.method: sha256-over-exact-file-bytes; plan excluded to avoid circularity

sensitivity: randomisation-sensitivity: absolute Spearman of scene-cluster mean score and outcome; exchangeability unit scene-cluster; exact enumeration when cluster-count factorial <=100000, otherwise 10000 Monte Carlo permutations with seed 20260829 and plus-one p-value
analysis.degenerate_bootstrap_policy: conditionally compute the interval over valid whole-scene-cluster replicates only; always report requested, valid and one-class-or-nonfinite replicate counts and fractions over the requested denominator; fail closed when the degenerate fraction exceeds 0.10 or the valid fraction is below 0.90
analysis.analysis_input_contract: strict freeze-bound envelope; exactly 24 locked held-out base assignments are the confirmatory denominator; all rows reconcile to candidate episode, scene and partition; both target-correction and no-new-defect endpoints are mandatory; duplicate rows are repeated measures and excluded from the independent denominator
analysis.duplicate_consistency_statistic: proportion of linked duplicate/base pairs with exact simultaneous agreement on valid, target-correction, no-new-defect and preservation-rating fields; computed by analysis code and never accepted from the caller
analysis.automatic_input_binding: endpoint scores and edit-locality are accepted only from a separately content-addressed locked score manifest; its exact method commitment, candidate manifest hash, episode IDs, and candidate before/after hashes must validate
analysis.freeze_receipt_verification: analysis validates the freeze status, receipt-hash syntax, assignment content hash and candidate assignment; verification of the accountable external freeze receipt bytes remains a pre-analysis steward custody gate and is not claimed by this repository-only analyzer

contingencies.missingness: retain-denominators-and-reasons; report locked-cluster, conservative-failure, and prespecified sensitivity analyses
contingencies.one_class_or_sparse_held_out: report counts; metric not evaluable; no promotion; require new frozen validation wave
contingencies.failed_reliability: no aggregation or promotion; revise interface or rubric and run a new versioned study
contingencies.wide_or_degenerate_interval: report uncertainty; do not substitute an unplanned method to rescue a threshold
contingencies.threshold_failure: retain result; do not retune on held-out; revise metric and use a fresh held-out wave
